text: 230 examples to learn from, 64 checks for tuning, 120 held out for the test. 8 labels.
Running live on Nebius Token Factory.
Base Nemotron 3 Nano got 89 of 120 held-out tickets right (74%).
Nemotron 3 Ultra scored 90% at $0.196 per 1,000 calls: the bar to chase.
Nemotron 3 Super found 5 failure types in 9 mistakes on the tuning checks.
Feedback misclassified as product question: Model confuses feature requests or general praise/feedback with specific product inquiries due to overlapping keywords like 'add', 'support', 'plan'.
Feedback misclassified as shipping: Model incorrectly tags positive feedback about shipping speed/packaging as a shipping issue instead of general feedback.
Shipping confused with billing: Model mislabels shipping-related queries (tracking, delivery) as billing when payment timing or transaction context is mentioned.
Shipping misclassified as account access: Model confuses delivery instructions (e.g., neighbor drop-off) with account management due to user authentication context.
Nemotron 3 Ultra wrote 131 cases; Nemotron 3 Super agreed with 123. 8 dropped.
Wrote a playbook for Nemotron 3 Nano: 5 house rules and 10 worked examples from the agreed cases.
Taught Nemotron 3 Nano got 104 of 120 right (87%), up from 74%.
Shipped. Taught beats base by 15 of 120 held-out tickets (74% to 87%). Endpoint: nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B + playbook.
